newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Malayan Credit group offers best land bid.
newsitem.headline: Malayan Credit group offers best land bid.

text.p: Singapore's Urban Redevelopment Authority (URA) said on Tuesday a group of companies including Malayan Credit Ltd had submitted the highest bid in a tender for a 59,663.6 square metre parcel of light industrial land.
The URA said in a statement the group had bid Singapore $113.19 million for the land.
It said another tender, for a block of land of the same size, had attracted a highest bid of S101.15 million from Rutile Pte Ltd.
Both blocks of land were sold on 60-year leases, the URA said. -- Singapore newsroom (65 8703199)
